result:
Posts can now be scheduled with an optional "Publish at" date, and `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (7 tests, including 5 new ones in `tests/PostScheduling.test.ts`).

Visibility is checked at read time, so nothing has to run when a date passes. A scheduled post returns 404 on its page for guests and other users, and it is left out of the posts list, search and the home page's latest posts. Its author sees it everywhere, with a "Scheduled" note. Dates are normalised to UTC ISO text on write, and an invalid value gets the same 422 as an empty title.

The changes are in `db/schema.ts` plus a new migration (`ADD published_at`), `app/Models/Post.ts` (new `visiblePosts(viewerId)` query helper), `PostPolicy.view`, `PostController`, `HomeController`, `PostValidator` and `PostResource`. The New and Edit forms get the field through a small helper in `resources/js/lib/publish-at.ts`, and `.guren/*.gen.ts` was regenerated. `guren check` has no new failures, only the existing warning that DashboardController has no test file.
